prompt: The note on the door (says / tells) that the driver could not leave the box because a big dog was standing by the gate.
explanation_ru: После глагола say не нужно прямое дополнение-адресат перед придаточным с that (say that...), тогда как tell требует указания, кому именно сообщается информация.

prompt: The park ranger politely (said / told) the dog owner that the city council required all pets to stay on leashes near the duck pond.
explanation_ru: В конструкции с прямым дополнением (the dog owner) и придаточным предложением используется глагол tell (tell someone that...).

prompt: In her cookbook, the author notes that a famous chef once (said / told) her to let pancake batter rest for thirty minutes for a lighter texture.
explanation_ru: Глагол tell используется в модели tell + дополнение + инфинитив с to (told her to let...) для передачи совета или инструкции.

prompt: While their dogs played, the two neighbors (said / told) each other that garden gnomes had been disappearing from yards across town.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell сразу ставится прямое дополнение-адресат (each other) без предлога перед придаточным с that.

prompt: In his email, the supervisor (said / told) the staff what the city inspector had recommended regarding the safe disposal of batteries and glass.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell сразу следует адресат (the staff), а затем косвенный вопрос с what (tell someone what...).

prompt: Liam (said / told) his flatmate that the landlord had sent a message promising to fix the broken washing machine tomorrow morning.
explanation_ru: Поскольку сразу после глагола указан собеседник (his flatmate) без предлога to, требуется глагол told.

prompt: When the parent apologized for the child's sudden laughter during a quiet scene, the usher kindly (said / told) that the whole row seemed to enjoy it.
explanation_ru: Адресат не указан сразу после глагола, поэтому используется конструкция said that...

prompt: At lunch, Claire (said / told) her colleague which dish the chef had recommended as the freshest fish of the day.
explanation_ru: Конструкция tell + адресат (her colleague) + придаточное с which используется для передачи конкретной информации собеседнику.

prompt: During the family dinner, Mark (said / told) us that Aunt Clara had promised to pay for everyone's late-night taxi rides home.
explanation_ru: После глагола стоит прямое дополнение us без предлога, поэтому необходимо выбрать told.

prompt: A printed sign on the clinic's main door (says / tells) patients that the elevator is under repair and stair assistance is available at reception.
explanation_ru: Объявление обращается непосредственно к адресату (patients), поэтому используется переходный глагол tells (tell someone that...).

prompt: A tourist stood too close to a fragile barrier next to platform four. The station inspector walked over and (said / told) him not to lean against the ancient stone wall. He then (spoke / talked) to the crowd about preserving historic railway buildings.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске используется модель tell someone not to do something (told him not to lean). Во втором для официального обращения к аудитории используется глагол spoke (spoke to the crowd).

prompt: Elena walked out of the interview room looking relieved. She immediately (said / told) the next candidate what questions the panel had asked her inside. She also (said / told) that the interviewers were friendly and wanted practical examples.
explanation_ru: В первом случае после глагола идет адресат (the next candidate), поэтому нужен глагол told. Во втором адресат не указан перед that, поэтому используется said.

prompt: At the museum entrance, a father complained loudly when the scanner rejected his passes. The clerk calmly (said / told) that his online tickets were valid only for next month. She then (spoke / talked) very slowly so he could understand the refund policy.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске перед придаточным с that нет адресата, поэтому ставится said. Во втором описывается манера речи и произнесения слов (spoke slowly), где используется глагол speak.

prompt: Before anyone lit a Bunsen burner, the chemistry teacher gathered the class around the front bench. She (said / told) the students how to adjust the gas valves safely. Finally, she (said / told) everyone to put on their protective goggles.
explanation_ru: Оба пропуска требуют глагола told: сначала в конструкции tell someone how to do something, а затем в конструкции tell someone to do something.

prompt: The biologist reviewed the overnight footage from the forest trail. In her field report, she (said / told) that a camera trap had captured a wild cat crossing a stream on a fallen tree. She later (spoke / talked) with her research team about moving two more cameras upstream.
explanation_ru: Для передачи содержания отчета без указания адресата используется said that. Для обсуждения планов с коллегами подходит talked with (или spoke with).

prompt: The store assistant clearly ___ how to reach aisle fourteen in the self-service pickup zone.
explanation_ru: Только глагол tell может принимать прямое дополнение-адресат (the customer) без предлога перед вопросительным словом how.

prompt: When the team captain politely questioned the low score, the judge ___ that stepping out of bounds carried an automatic deduction.
explanation_ru: Глагол say требует предлога to перед адресатом (said to him), тогда как tell используется без предлога (told him).

prompt: The repair worker ___ that dirt was blocking the charging port and did not ask for any money to clean it.
explanation_ru: Перед придаточным предложением с that прямое дополнение me без предлога употребляется только после глагола told.

prompt: The passenger claimed the desk worker ___ that his guitar could go on the plane with him, so the gate worker called her manager to check.
explanation_ru: В конструкции с прямым дополнением him и придаточным с that правильным выбором является глагол tell (had told him).

prompt: A friendly local bus driver said us about a quiet hidden beach just outside the city.
answer: A friendly local bus driver told us about a quiet hidden beach just outside the city.
accepted_answers: A friendly local bus driver told us about a quiet hidden beach just outside the city.
explanation_ru: Глагол say не употребляется с прямым дополнением us без предлога; для передачи информации кому-либо используется конструкция tell someone about something.

prompt: The strict history tutor told to each student when the final research essay was due.
answer: The strict history tutor told each student when the final research essay was due.
accepted_answers: The strict history tutor told each student when the final research essay was due.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell предлог to перед адресатом не ставится (told each student, а не told to each student).

prompt: As thick fog rolled down the mountain, the ranger told us which trail to take back to the lodge.
answer: As thick fog rolled down the mountain, the ranger told us which trail to take back to the lodge.
accepted_answers: As thick fog rolled down the mountain, the ranger told us which trail to take back to the lodge.
explanation_ru: Предложение построено верно: использована правильная модель tell + прямое дополнение (us) + вопросительное слово с инфинитивом (which trail to take).

prompt: The warehouse manager is upset because the delivery driver arrived at the wrong loading gate despite receiving a clear map earlier. Which sentence describes this situation accurately?
options: The manager spoke the driver that he had arrived at the wrong loading gate.
The manager said the driver that he had arrived at the wrong loading gate.
The manager told to the driver that he had arrived at the wrong loading gate.
The manager told the driver that he had arrived at the wrong loading gate.
explanation_ru: Глагол tell требует прямого дополнения без предлога to (told the driver), тогда как глаголы say и speak так не употребляются.

prompt: Rewrite the sentence using 'told' instead of 'explained to': The librarian explained to the new visitor how to get a free library card and use the printers.
answer: The librarian told the new visitor how to get a free library card and use the printers.
accepted_answers: The librarian told the new visitor how to get a free library card and use the printers.
explanation_ru: При замене explained to на told предлог to опускается, так как глагол tell присоединяет прямое дополнение (the new visitor) напрямую.
